links.outcome: Validity of citations in LLM imaging recommendations
links.effect: Citation quality range 0.40-2.00; Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash hallucinated citations in 80% and 76% of prompts, worse than all other models (P < .001).
links.quote: Citation quality (range 0.40-2.00) was the most variable; Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 2.5 Flash hallucinated citations in 80% and 76% of prompts, respectively, performing worse than all other models (P < .001).

links.outcome: LLM imaging modality appropriateness versus ACR guideline criteria
links.effect: Appropriateness scores ranged 1.60-1.88 out of 2.00 with no significant pairwise differences; all LLMs selected appropriate modalities with reasonable justification.
links.quote: Appropriateness scores (range 1.60-1.88 out of 2.00) revealed no significant pairwise differences.

screen.reason: The study is an empirical benchmark comparing the baseline performance and hallucination rates of several LLMs on 50 clinical vignettes based on ACR criteria, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
